text:
carla: Quick heads-up: I'm refreshing the Hello quickstart for SDK v8 and the new token convention. Will open a PR in ~30m. Checklist: env var rename, JS/Py snippet tweaks, Dockerfile minimal multistage, and run snippet smoke tests.
ben: Nice. Anything breaking we should call out in migration notes?
carla: Only the ENV rename: REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_TOKEN. Also move example to `new RedwoodClient({ token: process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN })` instead of inline key. I'll add a migration callout and example sed.
alice: Can you paste the updated snippets so I can glance?
carla: JS snippet:```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ token: process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN });
const res = await client.text.generate({ model: 'redwood-alpha', prompt: 'Hello, world!' });
console.log(res.output[0].content);
```
carla: Py snippet:```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(token=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_TOKEN'))
out = client.text.generate(model='redwood-alpha', prompt='Hello, world!')
print(out.output[0].content)
```
david: I'll run these in the devcontainer and smoke them. Docs snippet-runner is flaky on macs, so I'll run locally: `./scripts/run-snippets.sh docs/quickstart`.
carla: Thanks. If you see OLD env var anywhere, leave a TODO comment in the PR.
elaine: FYI linkchecker flagged an old slug: `/docs/quickstart/auth` -> now `/docs/quickstart/credentials`. CI shows a 404.
carla: Good catch, I'll update internal links and add a redirect in the docs app.
doc-bot: snippet-runner started for docs/quickstart at 1765432320 122.
chris: When you change Dockerfile, keep it minimal for first-run users. Previous one pulled dev deps and confused people. Multistage with only runtime deps is best.
carla: Agreed. I'll add a short note in Docker section and example multistage Dockerfile snippet.
ben: I'll add a brief migration bullet: "Rename REDWOOD_API_KEY to REDWOOD_TOKEN and rotate keys" to reduce support hits.
alice: I'll review the PR once it's up. Ping me @alice here and add the PR link. I can do a quick pass for wording and sample outputs. :eyes:
david: Ran snippet locally: two minor things: (1) README still shows old env var in a bash code block, (2) python snippet had a trailing comma that trips older Python versions. I made a tiny branch to fix and can open a PR against your branch if you want.
carla: Please do. I'll wait to consolidate both branches before opening the main PR. CI: docs + snippet-runner + linkchecker must pass.
chris: One more ask: add a one-line "Where to find your token" under Authentication pointing to Console -> API keys. New users keep looking in settings.
carla: Adding that with a screenshot placeholder and a link to console docs.
doc-bot: snippet-runner finished: 2 warnings (trailing comma in python example, minor nondeterministic output), 0 errors.
carla: Perfect. I'll open the PR now and assign reviews to @alice and @ben. Dropping the link here when live. If CI flaps, @david can re-run the job. :thumbsup:
ben: Thanks for handling cleanup.
alice: LGTM in advance, will review after ping.
carla: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/499 100. Assigning @alice @ben for review. Will update with screenshot + redirect after reviews.
david: Kicking off local e2e: `./scripts/run-snippets.sh docs/quickstart --container` 120. Will post if anything else pops.
carla: Closing thread once merged. Thanks all! :wave:
